summaryZh: Reinagel lab 研究大鼠在视觉引导下选择动作，关注感官不确定性中的奖励驱动选择、速度准确性权衡与盲视。方法包括定量视觉行为、计算建模、损伤实验与药理学。
researchQuestions: 大鼠的哪些视觉行为依赖初级视觉皮层？

evidence.quote: The Reinagel lab studies perceptually guided selection of action in the visually behaving rat. Our primary experimental tool is quantitative visual behavior.
building computational models to explain reward-motivated choice behavior in the face of sensory uncertainty. Lesions and pharmacology are used to probe neural mechanisms.
One current focus is the speed-accuracy trade-off
She started her lab at UCSD in 2003.
The Reinagel lab studies perceptually guided selection of action in the visually behaving rat.

A second focus is blindsight: identifying which visual behaviors are dependent on primary visual cortex in the rat, and characterizing visual decision-making and learning in V1-independent visual behaviors.
